description: Screenshot of Q drop No.315 (10/01/18, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI) linking a Fox News tweet and quoting '[9:00] "We will be voting this week." Heading to TN now. Q', with 'Heading to TN now' underlined in red — posted as a 'proof' tying Q to President Trump's trip to a Tennessee rally that day.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI. 10/01/18 (Mon) 14:33:26 No.315. https://twitter.com/FoxNews/status/1046848272063770630. [9:00]. "We will be voting this week." Heading to TN now. Q

description: Digital graphic of the Punisher comic-franchise skull emblem rendered in the stars and stripes of the American flag on a black background, with small 'Q' letters worked into both eye sockets. Red text below reads 'DOITQ!', a QAnon rallying phrase. The Punisher skull was widely adopted as a Q movement emblem.
